contract: CDB Simplificado capacity contract (application code only)

notes.String.length(): text capacities reported as utf16_code_units (Java String.length()).
notes.enforcement.automatic: true = length/format checked inside verificar() on every atribuirConteudo.
notes.enforcement.caller_dependent: true = limit only enforced if a caller explicitly invokes the check (NumeroReal.verificarTamanhoPermetido).
notes.kind=none: raw String / surrogate Id / many-to-one FK / unlimited text: no declared restriction in application code.
notes.serializer_routes: populated only for fields whose fixed-width route is statically known (CodigoIF/CodIsin); other routes are layout/runtime-selected and left empty.
notes.oracle: no Oracle column types/limits inferred (out of scope).

table_notes: TITULO is a @hibernate.joined-subclass of INSTRUMENTO_FINANCEIRO on NUM_IF (TituloDO.java:29-30); columns listed are TITULO's own.
CONDICAO_IF is the <class> supertable; JUROS_FLUTUANTE and RESGATE are <joined-subclass> sharing PK NUM_CONDICAO_IF (CondicaoIFDO.hbm.xml).
EVENTO is authoritatively mapped in EventoDO.hbm.xml (EventoDO.java is POJO-only).
Collection mappings (@hibernate.set one-to-many) and commented-out/unannotated getters were excluded as non-columns.
dynamic_routing: Fixed-width serializer widths depend on which VisitanteArquivo* layout the runtime selects; not a per-field global limit.
serializer_routes is populated only for CodigoIF and CodIsin, whose route widths are statically known. For CodigoIF: mainframe/garantias=14 reject, SELIC ASEL023=6 truncate, CETIP=raw.
All other fields' serializer routes are layout/runtime-selected and left empty (unknown), per the requirement not to combine route-specific limits.
unresolved_paths: NumeroReal-family capacities (ValorMonetario/ValorBase/ValorColateral/Preco/PrecoReal/PrecoPU/Fator/Percentual/Quantidade/NumeroDeVolumes/NumeroReal) are DECLARED int/dec but only ENFORCED when a caller explicitly invokes NumeroReal.verificarTamanhoPermetido (NumeroReal.java:668); JDBC bind is Types.NUMERIC with no scale enforcement (NumeroReal.java:740). -> caller_dependent=true.

NumeroInteiro-family length (14 digits) is enforced automatically inside verificar (NumeroInteiro.java:412) but only if inicializar() ran and set tamanhoMaximo before content assignment (framework lifecycle assumption).
PrecoPU and NumeroDeVolumes declare part sizes (10/8 and 8/4) that are never applied; effective capacity falls back to NumeroReal 10/10 (confidence=medium).
NumeroSerie sets 10 in inicializar but a specific path resets it to 4 (NumeroSerie.java:73).
NumeroAssociacao default is 8 but overloaded constructors accept a caller-supplied tamanhoMaximo.
DadoOperacao (VAL_DADO_ANTERIOR/ATUAL in DADO_OPERACAO) is a polymorphic operation-data value type; capacity not statically resolvable.

Many-to-one FK columns (java_type ending in 'DO') and surrogate Id columns carry no declared capacity in application code (kind=none); their real bound is the referenced PK / Oracle column (out of scope).

Types with tamanhoMaximo=0 (NumeroLeilao, NumeroNegocio, NuOp, CodigoTipoIF, CodigoAssociacao, CodigoOrigemCetipNet, HashCode, Xml, Texto, TextoLimitado raw, IdTabelaTipo domains) declare no length limit -> kind=none.
No Oracle column types/lengths were inferred (explicitly out of scope).
